parameters.name: AclEntryComment
parameters.description:
The description of the access control policy group entry.

The description must be 2 to 100 characters in length and must start with an uppercase letter, lowercase letter, or Chinese character. It can contain digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-).

parameters.name: AclEntryIp
parameters.description: The IPv6 address or IPv6 CIDR block to add to the access control policy group entry. Example: 12XX:0:0:XXXX::0102 or 12XX:0:0:XXXX::/60.

parameters.name: AclId
parameters.description: The ID of the access control policy group to which the IP entry belongs.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the access control policy group.
